candidates.source_name: ARBK — Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve të Kosovës (official business registry portal)
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory Kosovo business register within the Ministry of Industry, Entrepreneurship and Trade. It is the legally mandated record of every registered legal entity, its authorised representatives (perfaqesues i autorizuar), directors and owners — including banks, microfinance institutions, payment/e-money institutions and their local suppliers. Registry filings capture leadership and shareholder change even when no press release is ever issued, and the register itself enumerates the population of entities to track.
candidates.source_subtype: national company register / official registry portal
candidates.access_status: public, free basic search; deeper extracts may require request/fee
candidates.legal_status: official government publication; personal data of officers subject to Kosovo data-protection law
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic entity-by-entity lookup for a curated watchlist of licensed banks/PSPs/vendors; snapshot officer and shareholder fields and diff between runs. Avoid bulk automated scraping/redistribution — reported as not authorised.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for the registry's official name + English confirmation search
queries_used: ARBK Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve të Kosovës regjistri online kërkim biznesi
Kosovo business registry ARBK online search company extract directors

candidates.why_relevant: The transactional front-end where registration and CHANGE requests are filed — change of owner, change of authorised representative/director, statute and capital changes. It is where organisation-change events originate before they surface in any extract; understanding its request taxonomy tells us exactly which change types exist and are recordable.
candidates.access_status: login required (eKosova/citizen ID) for filing; informational pages public
candidates.legal_status: official government system; account-gated areas out of scope for collection
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual review of public informational pages to map change-request types; do not attempt authenticated access.
queries_used: ARBK Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve të Kosovës regjistri online kërkim biznesi

candidates.source_name: ARBK Open (arbk.org) — independent open mirror of the Kosovo business register
candidates.why_relevant: Independent aggregation of ~270,000 Kosovo businesses from the public register, with search by owner, activity (NACE), municipality, and 'recently added businesses' feeds plus a documented API endpoint. Far more tractable for systematic monitoring and for enumerating supplier/vendor companies around banks than the official portal.
candidates.source_subtype: third-party registry mirror / open data aggregator with API
candidates.legal_status: third-party republication of public register data; not an official source — verify against ARBK before relying
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the API / new-registrations listing on a schedule; cross-check any officer or ownership field against the official ARBK extract before using it as evidence.
queries_used: ARBK Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve të Kosovës regjistri online kërkim biznesi

candidates.why_relevant: A commercial API wrapper over Kosovo business registry data; if it exposes officer/representative fields it becomes the cheapest programmatic route to detect director changes across a watchlist.
candidates.access_status: unverified; likely API key / paid tier
candidates.legal_status: commercial third party; terms of use must be reviewed before automated use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Evaluate field coverage and licence terms; only adopt if officer/shareholder fields and change history are present.
queries_used: Kosovë regjistri i pronarëve përfitues beneficial ownership register ARBK

candidates.source_name: Regjistri i Pengut (ARBK pledge / security-interests register)
candidates.why_relevant: The pledge register run alongside ARBK records secured-creditor filings. Filings name the financial institution and the officer/representative signing on its behalf, and reveal which banks/PSPs are active with which counterparties — an indirect but legally mandated trace of who is authorised to act for an institution.
candidates.access_status: public search portal (search may require entity identifiers)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted lookups by creditor name for licensed banks and MFIs; low frequency.
queries_used: ARBK Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve të Kosovës regjistri online kërkim biznesi

candidates.source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes laws, government and Assembly decisions including appointments to boards of public bodies and to the Central Bank of Kosovo's governing bodies, plus statutory changes affecting registration and licensing. Trilingual (sq/sr/en) full-text searchable act database — the canonical record of state-side leadership appointments in the financial sector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled keyword monitoring of new acts for terms like 'emërim', 'shkarkim', 'Bordi i BQK-së', 'Guvernator', 'imenovanje'; also monitor the mobile-app/RSS style feeds if exposed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for official gazette + appointment terms
queries_used: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës gzk.rks-gov.net vendim emërim

candidates.source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (CBK register of licensed financial institutions)
candidates.why_relevant: The authoritative enumeration of every licensed bank, MFI, NBFI, insurer, pension fund and payment institution in Kosovo, published as dated PDF snapshots. This is the master watchlist that makes registry monitoring tractable: each entity on it is then looked up in ARBK for officer/shareholder changes. Successive dated editions also reveal entries/exits and name changes.
candidates.legal_status: official regulator publication; central register maintained for public inspection under Law 04/L-093
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download each new dated PDF, parse entity names/licence types, diff against previous edition, and use the entity list to drive ARBK lookups.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for the licensed-institutions register
queries_used: BQK regjistri i institucioneve financiare të licencuara bankat lista
local_language_terms_used: Banka Qendrore e Republikës së Kosovës

candidates.source_name: Ligji Nr. 04/L-093 për Bankat, Institucionet Mikrofinanciare dhe Institucionet Financiare Jobankare (via GZK)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines the legal duty to maintain a central public register of financial institutions and the notification/approval duties for changes in shareholders and governing bodies. Establishes WHAT must be filed and therefore what registry evidence should exist for every leadership or ownership change — essential for judging completeness of registry-derived signals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read to codify mandatory-filing rules; re-check on amendment.
queries_used: BQK regjistri i institucioneve financiare të licencuara bankat lista

candidates.source_name: BQK licensing and registration manuals (Manuali i Licencimit / Manuali i Regjistrimit)
candidates.why_relevant: Spells out that institutions must notify BQK of changes in ownership and in the composition of governing bodies, and that BQK assesses fit-and-proper of shareholders, beneficial owners and administrators at licensing and at every subsequent change. Tells us which change events trigger a regulator record that can be requested or observed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off extraction of notification triggers and timelines to inform monitoring cadence.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) on board decisions and shareholder approval
queries_used: BQK vendimet e bordit licencimi ndryshimi i strukturës drejtuese aprovim aksionar

candidates.source_name: RQLL — Regjistri Qendror i Lejeve dhe Licencave (Central Registry of Permits and Licences)
candidates.why_relevant: Public electronic registry, run by the Office of the Prime Minister under Law 04/L-202, of every permit/licence issued by central institutions, including financial-sector authorisations and registration of authorised representatives. Enumerates which authority issues what, revealing further registers and licence-holder lists to track.
candidates.access_status: public, searchable by activity, institution and law
candidates.legal_status: official government register, statutorily open to the public
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate financial-sector licence types and issuing bodies to discover downstream licence-holder registers; refresh quarterly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for the permits and licences registry
queries_used: "lejelicenca.rks-gov.net" regjistri i lejeve dhe licencave Kosovë

candidates.source_name: Gjykata Komerciale e Kosovës (Commercial Court) — decisions and case register
candidates.why_relevant: Established by Law 08/L-015, the Commercial Court hears company, commercial and registration disputes — including challenges to registry entries, shareholder disputes and director removals. Its published decisions name officers and expose organisation changes that are contested rather than merely filed.
candidates.access_status: sessions public; decisions published after party notification; a dedicated court decision portal exists but its exact URL was not confirmed in this pass
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the court's own decision-publication page on the Kosovo judiciary domain, then keyword-monitor for licensed financial institutions' names.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for commercial court decision publication

candidates.access_status: public search; some functions require a free account; snapshot may be stale

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use Aleph search/API for person-name pivots on a curated executive watchlist; treat as a lead generator and confirm in ARBK.

negative_findings.description: BIFIDEX, the Western Balkans joint business-registers platform, offers exactly the capability this cell wants — real-time notification when any change is recorded in the official register for a company or its authorised persons — but its published member coverage is Serbia, Montenegro, Bosnia & Herzegovina (RS), North Macedonia and Albania. No Kosovo registry membership was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched for Bifidex + Kosovo; all member listings found omit Kosovo. Also noted the platform's governance is described as institutionally fragile with periods of inactivity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no off-the-shelf regional change-notification service covering Kosovo registry filings, so change detection for XK must be built in-house by diffing ARBK snapshots.

negative_findings.description: No open, bulk or machine-readable feed of Kosovo company OFFICERS/DIRECTORS/SHAREHOLDERS was found. OpenCorporates records officers, directors, shareholders and accounts as not available for the Kosovo register (Open Company Data Index score 15/100), and reporting indicates automated bulk extraction from the ARBK portal for commercial redistribution is not authorised.
negative_findings.result_summary: Officer-level data appears obtainable only per-entity, via the ARBK portal extract or paid extract brokers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring leadership change through the register will be per-entity and rate-limited, so a tightly curated watchlist (driven by the BQK licensed-institutions list) is mandatory rather than optional.

negative_findings.description: Searching in Albanian for a Kosovo beneficial-ownership register (regjistri i pronarëve përfitues) returned only ARBK's general pages and Serbia's UBO register. No dedicated public Kosovo UBO register portal was identified in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Beneficial-owner information appears to be collected by BQK during fit-and-proper assessment rather than exposed in a public searchable UBO register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ultimate ownership changes behind banks/PSPs may not be publicly observable in Kosovo; this limits the pointer value of the registry for ownership (as opposed to director) change.

negative_findings.description: The exact URL and query interface of ARBK's public company SEARCH (as opposed to the login/registration front-end at rbk.rks-gov.net and the informational site at arbk.rks-gov.net) was not pinned down in this pass, nor was it confirmed which officer fields appear in a free public result.
negative_findings.result_summary: Secondary sources state basic search is free, English-capable and account-free, but this was not established from the portal itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design (what can be diffed automatically vs what needs a paid extract) depends on this; it should be resolved by a hands-on portal walkthrough, not more searching.

negative_findings.description: Unlike many jurisdictions, no evidence was found that the Kosovo Official Gazette publishes routine COMPANY filings (director changes, statute amendments) — it appears to carry laws, regulations and state-body decisions/appointments instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: GZK is valuable for public-sector and central-bank appointments, but is unlikely to be a systematic feed of private bank/PSP director changes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-investment in gazette monitoring as a substitute for registry monitoring for commercial entities.

negative_findings.description: Sources reference downloading full Commercial Court decisions from the court's official website, but the specific decisions-publication URL on the Kosovo judiciary domain was not located in this pass; the cases are also still being migrated from manual registers into the SMIL electronic case-management system.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only aggregated third-party compilations of Commercial Court decisions were found directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Contested director removals and shareholder disputes may be visible only through the court; the canonical publication endpoint still needs to be identified.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language (sr) coverage for this cell is thin. Searches in Serbian returned mostly Serbia/BiH registries rather than Kosovo-specific registry content, and no Serbian-language ARBK interface or Serbian-language Kosovo registry search terminology in active use was confirmed beyond the official name 'Kosovska Agencija za Registraciju Preduzeća'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sr-language queries against Kosovo-Serb media and north-Kosovo business coverage (e.g. 'ovlašćeno lice', 'promena direktora', 'izvod iz registra', combined with named banks) and check whether ARBK/GZK expose sr-language interfaces or documents.

coverage_gaps.description: No feed, RSS, notification service, or dated change log for Kosovo registry filings was identified. Change detection depends entirely on self-built snapshot diffing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Prototype a per-entity snapshot-and-diff routine over the BQK licensed-institutions watchlist, with polite rate limits; investigate whether arbk.org's API exposes an updated-at or new-registrations endpoint that can act as a trigger.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell is well covered for licensed banks and financial institutions but weakly covered for their SUPPLIERS (POS/ATM vendors, IT integrators, cash-in-transit, card personalisation), whose registry records are the same but whose identities are not enumerated anywhere obvious.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use e-Prokurimi award notices and ARBK NACE-code filtering (arbk.org supports 615 NACE codes) to build a supplier watchlist, then apply the same officer-diff monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unclear whether ARBK exposes HISTORICAL extracts (prior officers, prior statutes) publicly or only 'current' extracts; secondary vendors describe extracts as 'relevant at the moment of the request'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm availability and cost of historical extracts directly with ARBK or via one extract broker on a single test entity; this determines whether backfill of leadership history is feasible at all.

coverage_gaps.description: Data-protection constraints on officer personal data and a reported prohibition on automated bulk extraction for commercial redistribution were noted but not read at source (law text / ARBK terms of use).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain and read ARBK's terms of use and the applicable Kosovo personal-data-protection provisions before designing any automated collection; record the permitted-use envelope in the source register.

brief: Kosovo's leadership-and-organisation-change record is anchored on two official pillars: ARBK (Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve të Kosovës), the statutory company register where director, authorised-representative, shareholder and statute changes are legally filed, and BQK's dated PDF register of licensed financial institutions, which supplies the definitive watchlist of banks, MFIs, NBFIs and payment institutions to look up. The Official Gazette (gzk.rks-gov.net) complements these for state-side appointments — central bank board and public-body roles — but does not appear to carry routine private-company filings, while the Central Registry of Permits and Licences and the Commercial Court add licence-holder and dispute-side visibility. The practical constraint is openness rather than existence: officer and shareholder data is recorded as unavailable in bulk (OpenCorporates scores the register 15/100), no regional change-notification platform covers Kosovo (BIFIDEX excludes it), and no public UBO register was found, so change detection must be built as per-entity snapshot diffing over a curated watchlist, with third-party mirrors (arbk.org, OCCRP Aleph) as lead generators and paid extract brokers reserved for evidence-grade confirmation. Serbian-language routes into this cell remain the weakest dimension and need a dedicated pass.
